The '''Emperor's Board''' was a charity that fed poor citizens on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Unidentified Gungan cook|cook]] was an operative of [[Whiplash]].<ref name="CN3">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref>
